verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an API-driven identity platform, so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents neither API versioning nor a deprecation policy. The only nearby items are adjacent features: Actions being 'versioned Node.js functions' (versioning of customer code, not of Auth0's APIs) and a marketing page urging an upgrade from Rules and Hooks to Actions (a migration pitch, not a deprecation policy). Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
